en: Improved the Claude in Chrome message in cloud sessions when the browser can't be reached: if you belong to more than one organization, it now says the extension must be signed in to the same one, and how to change that
zh: 改进了云 session 中无法访问浏览器时 Chrome 中的 Claude 的提示消息：如果你属于多个组织，现在会说明扩展必须登录到同一个组织，以及如何更改
